states.web: Not armed: the tint is at opacity 0 and the loop is stopped with the canvas cleared. Armed: the tint fades to full opacity, 26 sparks are seeded and one more is added every 0.14 s up to 30, rising with sway and twinkle. Typing adds energy that decays over about 0.8 s, speeding, enlarging and brightening the sparks and flaring on each stroke.

interaction.web: There is no pointer or keyboard interaction: both layers are pointer-events-none. The host calls the handle's bump() on each keystroke, which adds energy and queues a flare; the canvas is resized by a ResizeObserver at a pixel ratio capped at 2, and the animation frame and observer are cancelled on cleanup or when active turns false.

semantics.web: Both layers are aria-hidden with no role, name or text, so the field is decoration only and the meaning, max effort, is also given by the Effort chip and slider; the spark colour is read from the canvas's own computed text colour (text-agent), so it follows the theme.
